Messages.Author: LunaSlave
Messages.Body:
Another idea, inspired by the discussions recently about nerfing additional master phase action decks and by the card Retribution, although this is more direct and to the point than that. Doesn't kill additional MPA dead, but it definitely packs some bite! It's offset somewhat (too much? not enough?) by the crazy amount of bloat that additional MPA can generate.

Stretched Too Thin
Master: Out of Turn.
Only playable when a Methuselah uses 3 or more Master phase actions during his or her turn. That Methuselah loses 3 pool. Only one Stretched Too Thin may be played in a game.

Edited: Accidentally wrote "Methuselah takes 3 unpreventable damage" because I had the card Retribution on the brain even though I meant for this to hit the player, not their minions.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
How about something flatter?

Vanishing Grasp
Event
Inconnu. Whenever a methuselah plays a master card and he has already played another master card this turn, he burns 1 pool.

It scales with the number of MPA actions and also works on trifles so it will likely hurt everyone a bit and speed up tables.

Messages.Author: alek
Messages.Body: much better. It makes master deck life much harder. The question is should we try to nerf those decks? IMO the problem is about villein being a trifle (at the beggining trifle was supposed to improve some master cards, which basic effect was weaker than other masters. Villein effect is already huge, so why make it trifle. Not mentioning villein+giant's blood thing) and ashur tablets. I feel those cards should be targeted (errated) not additional MPA concept as a whole
